page.layout: One page of text, two columns of body text in the main column; margin notes in the left margin. Running head at top centre-right. Page number top left. Chapter heading and text below. Left margin: two marginal notes ("Motrix anima facultas duplex." and "ζωλικὴ.").

p.i: qua non recipit ejusmodi impressionem, sicuti nec aqua etiam quiescens recipit, quia statim amota re imprimente relabitur aqua, & obliterat vestigia impressionis, inde proverbium natum de oblivione rei alicujus;

In vento & rapida scribere oportet aqua, id est, non meminisse. Ita quoq; tametsi impressio imaginis rei alicujus facta fuerit in sic affectis humoribus, tamen motiones illæ vehementes obliterant, & quasi eluunt atq; delent habitum imaginis.
Quare consentaneum est, fieri memoriam per impressionem notarum ortam à rebus, quæ sensibus prius perceptæ sunt, quæ dum habentur & revera manent, earum dicitur memoria.

main_text.head: CAPUT XXIV. DE MOTU ANIMALIUM ET AFFECTIBUS.
main_text.p: Ic fuit apprehendens facultas animæ sentientis: Motrix est ejusdem animæ facultas, quæ motus animales in corpore ciet.Motrix anima facultas duplex.
ζωτικὴ est, quæ vitæ principium, sequens vitalem virtutem in animali defendit:

page.notes: Printed text is a fragment at the bottom ("Hæc") that continues onto the next page. The Greek words in the text ("ζωϊκὴ", "καὶ Αἰσθητικὴ", "ζωτικὴ") are transcribed as read; the first Greek word in the note and the one in the text may differ slightly in the printed form. The woodcut initial "S" of "Sic" is read as "I" with the woodcut decoration, transcribed as "Ic" following the printed letter shape; the likely word is "Sic" [?]. Ink faded in places; no line marked illegible.
